tips.text: Rank Bo to 30 before crafting Cadus or Tipedo with it; a consumed Bo is gone.
Never sell Bo; Cadus and Tipedo both need one, and Lesion needs Tipedo.
Build and rank Kunai before selling it if you plan to make Tipedo.
Expect the farm to be trivial; the only pain is the ingredient chain through Cadus, Tipedo and Lesion.
